headline: Canadian Dollar Rises to Four-Week High on Expectations of Bank of Canada Rate Hike
summary: The Canadian dollar reached a nearly four-week high as hawkish comments from Governor Tiff Macklem prompted markets to bet on an upcoming interest rate hike.
why: Expectations of higher central bank interest rates typically attract foreign capital seeking higher yields, strengthening the domestic currency.

impacts.name: Canadian Dollar
impacts.why: Hawkish central bank signals increase expectations of higher borrowing costs, driving currency gains.

why_moved: Governor Tiff Macklem's hawkish remarks shifted market predictions toward an imminent rate hike, boosting the currency despite subdued domestic inflation data.
